_comment: Canonical conversion flags for the parity corpus. Read by both tests/test_golden_parity.py (urdf2any side) and scripts/generate_reference.py (IsaacLab side) so the two stay in lockstep. urdf paths are relative to the repo root. merge_fixed_joints MUST be false: urdf2any does not merge fixed joints, and IsaacLab's UrdfConverterCfg defaults merge_fixed_joints to true, so the reference must override it.
